selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who is the first group in this passage?
questions.answer: They are the blessed and righteous people who listened to the Prophet and followed his guidance.

questions.question: In what way is he like a representative of his community?
questions.answer: In worship, he speaks as a devoted servant who presents his community’s servanthood before Allah.

questions.question: What does it mean that the community saw duties and stations inside the prayers in detail?
questions.answer: They understood that prayer is not just outward movements but a path of many meanings and responsibilities.

questions.question: What was their first response to the signs of Allah’s rule in the world?
questions.answer: They exalted Allah’s greatness.

questions.question: What is the difference between first observing creation and then beholding the Creator’s acts?
questions.answer: First they reflect on created things, then they rise to recognizing the living action of Allah behind them.

questions.question: What spiritual effect came from seeing subtle beauty in created things?
questions.answer: It stirred love and longing for the Creator.

questions.question: How did they answer His compassion shown through blessings?
questions.answer: They answered with gratitude and praise.

questions.question: What did they do when they saw the amazing art in creation?
questions.answer: They admired it, praised Allah for willing it, and testified that they believed.

questions.question: What was the result of carrying out these duties well?
questions.answer: They completed their life mission and reached an excellent rank.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is worship made of in front of the Lord of all worlds?
questions.answer: It is made of humble reverence, awareness of weakness, poverty, and need, and especially the prescribed prayers.

questions.question: Why is the first group called happy and good in this passage?
questions.answer: Because they listened to the Prophet and accepted the guidance brought through the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the Qur’an’s role for the community?
questions.answer: It is the means by which divine commands are delivered and understood.

questions.question: What did the community come to understand about prayer?
questions.answer: They understood that prayer contains many forms of worship and many refined duties.

questions.question: What was their response to witnessing the wonders of Allah’s lordship in creation?
questions.answer: They glorified Allah and honored His greatness.

questions.question: What did they do when they studied the messages written in creation?
questions.answer: They thought deeply and appreciated them.

questions.question: What change happened after they carried out these duties while reflecting on the unseen?
questions.answer: They rose to a deeper awareness of the Creator’s actions as if answering in His presence.

questions.question: Why is gratitude such a large part of their response?
questions.answer: Because they see blessings everywhere as gifts from Allah’s compassion.

questions.question: What made them rise above other creatures?
questions.answer: The blessing of faith, certainty, and faithfully carrying the Trust.

questions.question: How did they react to the wonders displayed in the exhibition of creatures?
questions.answer: They admired them, praised Allah, affirmed faith, and invited others to notice and respond.

questions.question: What special position did they receive on earth?
questions.answer: They became trustworthy vicegerents.

questions.question: What main idea about the first group appears in the opening lines of the passage?
questions.answer: The first group is praised because it listens, obeys, and responds properly to Allah through the Prophet and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What is one of those two responsibilities?
questions.answer: He worships Allah as a devoted servant and represents his community in servanthood.

questions.question: What is the connection between the Qur’an and the community’s duties?
questions.answer: By listening to the Qur’an, they understood the worship and responsibilities placed upon them.

questions.question: What response came from seeing shining works that reflect Allah’s names?
questions.answer: They praised Him and declared Him above all imperfection.

title: Transition to Reality Believers Listening to the Messenger and Entering High Stations Through Prayer
